column2:
DOOM's screen resolution.
640x400 = sharper.
320x200 = the original chunky pixels.
Takes effect after restarting the game.
Show DOOM on the Tablet itself
While you play, the Tablet on the desk shows a small copy of the DOOM screen.
Mute the game's music and background sound while playing
While you play DOOM, the game's background sound and the Cassette Player are muted.\nThey come back when DOOM pauses.
